# Triage

> Triage is an evidence-first crypto-tax forensic reconciliation product. It reconstructs supported cost basis across complex multi-chain histories, cites available evidence, and flags unresolved information for human review.

Canonical site: https://triage-amber-iota.vercel.app/
Founder: Abel Sabu — https://x.com/abl_373
Source repository: https://github.com/Abel356/Triage-Openclaw-Internship

## Primary pages

- Product, public demo, FAQ, and text walkthrough: https://triage-amber-iota.vercel.app/
- How I Used ClawUp to Build Triage: https://triage-amber-iota.vercel.app/guides/how-i-used-clawup-to-build-triage/

## What Triage does

- Reconstructs complex crypto transaction histories from available records.
- Cites observable evidence and separates it from interpretation.
- Labels missing or unresolved information instead of inventing basis.
- Produces a workpaper intended for taxpayer or CPA review.
- Provides a constrained, read-only public Telegram demonstration.

## Important limitations

- Triage does not provide tax advice.
- Triage does not file returns or sign as a preparer.
- Triage does not move funds or require private keys.
- A public-wallet inspection cannot establish wallet ownership, off-chain exchange records, historical fair-market value, complete cost basis, or final tax treatment by itself.
- A human must confirm source records, assumptions, valuation choices, and the final tax position.

## ClawUp relationship

ClawUp provides the public Telegram surface used to demonstrate Triage as a read-only agent. GOAT Network, ERC-8004, and x402 inform the identity, provenance, and per-report payment design. The current public experience is a constrained demonstration, not a claim that every identity, attestation, payment, or tax workflow is production-complete.

Triage referral link: https://clawup.org/?ref=287c2c37a2
Disclosure: use of this link may be attributed to Triage's Stage 2 ecosystem contribution.

Triage reconstructs supported crypto cost basis across complex multi-chain histories, cites available evidence, and flags unresolved information for human review.
